$comment: The standards LEXICON: what each identifier IS (issuing body, title, canonical URL). It is not the registry — the specs' `## N. Standards Alignment` tables say what Jx DOES about each standard, and scripts/docs/check-standards.ts joins the two. An id no spec cites fails (catalog-stale); an id no entry vouches for fails (id-unknown). That is the only offline way a typo'd RFC number can fail, since a wrong-but-well-formed rfc-editor.org URL is indistinguishable from a right one. Keep entries sorted by id (codepoint order).
